title: Formation of Gujarat
description: The bilingual Bombay State was divided into two separate states of Gujarat and Maharashtra based on language. Gujarat was established as a separate state for Gujarati speaking people.

title: Death of Chief Minister Balwantrai Mehta
description: Chief Minister Balwantrai Mehta died when his civilian aircraft was shot down by a Pakistani fighter jet during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965.

title: Nav Nirman Movement and Resignation
description: Student protests over high food prices and corruption allegations led to the Nav Nirman movement, culminating in the resignation of Chief Minister Chimanbhai Patel and the imposition of President's Rule.

title: Machchhu Dam Failure
description: The Machchhu II dam failed leading to a catastrophic flood in the town of Morbi and surrounding areas.

title: Bhuj Earthquake
description: A massive earthquake struck the Kutch district causing immense loss of life and severe destruction to infrastructure across the state.

title: Godhra Train Incident and Violence
description: The Sabarmati Express train was attacked and set on fire near the Godhra railway station resulting in 59 deaths. The incident led to large scale communal riots across the state of Gujarat.

title: Record Assembly Mandate
description: The Bharatiya Janata Party won a historic 156 out of 182 seats in the Gujarat Legislative Assembly elections, recording the highest number of seats ever won by a single party in the state.

title: Instrument of Accession
description: Maharaja Hari Singh signed the Instrument of Accession integrating the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir into the Dominion of India.

title: Article 35A Promulgated
description: A Presidential Order was issued adding Article 35A to the Constitution of India which empowered the state legislature to define permanent residents.

title: Change of Designations
description: The state constitution was amended to change the titles of Sadr-e-Riyasat to Governor and Prime Minister to Chief Minister.

title: Disputed Assembly Elections
description: Elections were held that were widely alleged to be rigged leading to political unrest and the onset of armed insurgency in the Kashmir valley.

title: Imposition of Governor Rule
description: Governor Rule was imposed following rising militancy and the subsequent exodus of Kashmiri Hindus from the Kashmir Valley.

title: Reorganisation Act 2019
description: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act came into effect bifurcating the state into the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.

title: Formation of Ladakh UT
description: Ladakh was established as a separate Union Territory without a legislature under the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act 2019.

title: Trifurcation of Punjab
description: The Punjab Reorganisation Act 1966 took effect separating Haryana as a new state and designating Chandigarh as a Union Territory.

title: Formation of Haryana
description: Haryana was carved out of the former state of East Punjab as a separate state on a linguistic basis.

title: Himachal Pradesh Statehood
description: Himachal Pradesh was elevated from a Union Territory to become the 18th full state of the Indian Union.

title: Formation of Uttaranchal
description: The state of Uttaranchal was carved out of the hill districts of Uttar Pradesh. It was later renamed to Uttarakhand.

title: National Capital Territory Act
description: The Constitution 69th Amendment Act 1991 granted Delhi a legislative assembly and a council of ministers.
